CREATE TABLE teacher_learning_action_assistance (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    correlation_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    causation_id VARCHAR(128),
    learning_action_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    context_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    context_id VARCHAR(255),
    support_context VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    hints_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    max_hint_level SMALLINT,
    intervention_used BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    observations JSONB NOT NULL,
    policy_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (personal_teacher_id, student_id)
        REFERENCES personal_teacher(id, student_id),
    UNIQUE (student_id, learning_action_id),
    CHECK (btrim(student_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(correlation_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(learning_action_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (context_type IN ('general', 'lesson', 'lesson_task', 'practice_task', 'project')),
    CHECK (
        (context_type = 'general' AND context_id IS NULL)
        OR
        (context_type <> 'general' AND context_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(context_id) <> '')
    ),
    CHECK (support_context IN ('independent', 'guided')),
    CHECK (hints_used BETWEEN 0 AND 1000),
    CHECK (max_hint_level IS NULL OR max_hint_level BETWEEN 0 AND 7),
    CHECK (
        (hints_used = 0 AND max_hint_level IS NULL)
        OR
        (hints_used > 0 AND max_hint_level IS NOT NULL)
    ),
    CHECK (
        support_context <> 'independent'
        OR
        (hints_used = 0 AND max_hint_level IS NULL AND intervention_used = FALSE)
    ),
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(observations) = 'array'),
    CHECK (jsonb_array_length(observations) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
    CHECK (btrim(policy_version) <> '')
);

CREATE INDEX teacher_learning_action_assistance_student_created_idx
    ON teacher_learning_action_assistance(student_id, created_at DESC);
